prompts.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent raster sprite atlas for a realistic fashion doll dress-up game.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent RGBA background, including all space between objects. No solid backdrop, checkerboard graphic, floor, cast shadows, frame, grid lines, labels, text, or watermark.
Primary request: create one square 1536 x 1536 image containing exactly 9 miniature footwear pairs in a uniform 3-column by 3-row invisible grid. Each of the nine equal cells contains exactly one matching LEFT AND RIGHT shoe pair, close together, symmetrically placed with toes toward the camera and shoes parallel to fit the two straight feet of a front-facing standing doll. No feet, legs, skin, people, mannequins, hands, shoe supports, or extra props.
Reading order, left to right then top to bottom:
Row 1: elegant satin pumps; clear glass high heels; tall fitted fashion boots.
Row 2: lace-up sneakers; delicate strappy sandals; ballet slippers with short tied ribbons.
Row 3: glossy rain boots; soft fluffy slippers; traditional Korean embroidered flower shoes (kkotsin).
Composition/framing: front-facing product camera, identical viewpoint throughout, whole pair centered within its cell. Every object and ribbon stays inside its own cell with at least 12 percent padding on every edge; no overlap or crossing cell boundaries. The pair is an isolated wearable sprite.
Style/medium: photorealistic miniature toy product photography, exquisite real fabric, stitching, smooth leather, clear glass and soft fur. Natural three-dimensional form and material highlights, never vector art, clipart, line illustration, flat diagram, or PowerPoint imagery.
Lighting: soft upper-left studio light with restrained form shading and no external ground shadows.
Color palette: neutral pearl white, silver, clear crystal and very pale ivory for later color tinting. Keep embroidery neutral pearl/silver. No color background.

Row 2: star hair clip; pearl headband; pointed witch hat; bunny-ear headband.
Row 3: cat-ear headband; medieval conical princess hennin with soft veil attached; Korean baessi-daenggi hair ornament; crescent moon tiara.
Row 4: bridal veil attached to a small comb; EMPTY; EMPTY; EMPTY.
Composition/framing: frontal view at doll-head height, open shallow elliptical wearable crown and headband openings. Head accessories are ready to overlay a front-facing doll head. No head, hair, skin, human, mannequin, display bust, or supports. Each entire isolated item centered within its own equal square cell and padded by at least 12 percent on each edge. Veils and ribbons must fit their own cells without crossing boundaries. No overlap.

Natural realistic material depth; never vector, clipart, diagram, flat illustration, or PowerPoint.
Lighting: soft upper-left studio light, restrained object form shading, no external shadows.
Color palette: pearl white, silver, clear crystal, very pale ivory neutral materials for later tint. The witch hat is pearl satin rather than black, all gems neutral clear crystal. No color background.
